Simple, rounded, slightly bulging cartoon shapes: clouds as round puffy scalloped balls, rocks as soft lumpy blobs, the sea as calm flat washes with only a few small curly wave strokes, the quay paving as a few big rounded stones. Large calm areas, low detail, no texture noise. Palette of an early two-colour film print from around 1930: only warm salmon-orange, brick red, peach, teal blue-green, muted sage, cream, sepia browns and near-black; no pure blue, no violet, no purple, no lemon yellow, no saturated modern colours; slightly faded and warm. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not a modern digital painting, not a postcard, no film grain, no scratches, no vignette (all of that is added later in the game).

The reference is only a flat block sketch: do not copy its flat colours or its hard straight edges, paint it.

Location: the small harbour of Lornholm, a fictional island in a northern sea, at dusk. A stone quay with a short wooden jetty runs along the lower third of the picture. On the left a small stone harbour-master's cottage with a lit window and a smoking chimney. On the quay: two barrels, a stack of crates, a coil of rope and an iron lantern on a wooden post. Calm sea, low clouds, a band of orange light at the horizon, the first stars.
